from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the party as written in the document")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Role in the case (e.g., Appellant, Defendant, Plaintiff)")

class MonetaryItem(BaseModel):
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The amount as written (e.g., '2297 元', '54,996.03 元')")
    payer_or_receiver: str | None = Field(description="Who pays or who receives the amount")
    label: str | None = Field(description="Type of amount (e.g., Court Fee, Fine, Damages, Compensation)")

class SentenceDetail(BaseModel):
    crime: str | None = Field(description="The crime committed, if specified")
    prison_term: str | None = Field(description="Length of prison term")
    probation_period: str | None = Field(description="Probation period if applicable")
    fine_amount: str | None = Field(description="Fine amount if applicable")

class DocumentRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extraction for one judgment document."""
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Civil or Criminal case type")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="Nature of dispute or crime (e.g., Loan contract, Arson)")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="Parties involved in the case")
    main_verdict: str | None = Field(description="Core ruling (e.g., Dismiss appeal, Maintain original, Specific sentencing)")
    court_fees: list[MonetaryItem] = Field(description="Court fees and payers")
    sentences: list[SentenceDetail] = Field(description="Criminal sentences and penalties")
    damages: list[MonetaryItem] = Field(description="Compensation or damages amounts")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentRecord]
